invalidated_v1_reason: Independent pre-run audit found unsupported Gemma system role, missing existing-event identity checks, and runner/lock hash mismatch. No model inference occurred under v1.
question: Does cached Gemma 2 2B IT clear a no-cost base-task gate on procedural multi-turn calendar API tasks, warranting a separate CPU update-feasibility protocol?
hypothesis: Greedy Gemma 2 2B IT completes at least 20 of 32 tasks and at least 4 of 8 in each operation family under the fixed CPU/resource budget.

scope.evidence_class: real pretrained language model on a synthetic procedurally generated task environment; base-feasibility only
not_established: performance on human-authored or external benchmark tasks
model update, checkpoint save/reload, or downstream generalization

task_suite.primary_metric: episode exact final-state success; preserve all existing target IDs and fields, create exactly the requested new events, remove requested IDs, preserve protected events byte-for-byte, and have no extra events
task_suite.response_contract: One strict JSON object per turn with exactly keys tool and arguments. Invalid JSON, extra keys, unknown tools, invalid operations, and failed tool calls count against the action budget; no regex extraction or constrained decoding.
task_suite.environment: Deterministic simulator exposes create_event, move_event, cancel_event; after every call the updated complete calendar and original request are returned.

runtime.platform: macOS; 10 CPU cores; 32 GiB physical memory

runner.device: CPU only; local_files_only model/tokenizer load; reject non-CPU parameter placement

acceptance.primary_gate: at least 20/32 exact-success episodes and at least 4/8 successes in every family
acceptance.resource_gate: all 32 tasks recorded; exit 0; CPU device; wall time <=2700 sec; peak RSS <=24 GiB; all model hashes match
acceptance.failure_rule: Any primary or resource gate failure retires this exact model/task/runtime pairing. Do not tune prompts, parser, task generation, action budget, or threshold and rerun this cohort.
acceptance.decision_if_pass: Authorize only a separately frozen CPU update-cost smoke; no learner confirmation or capability claim.
acceptance.decision_if_fail: Do not train this pairing. Preserve full traces and return to candidate selection.
